exact_statement: For every actual Boolean sign f on a finite uniform cube with entropy in bits, every rank-r binary matrix V, every r-coordinate physical pivot block A with V_A invertible, and every syndrome word y0, set Y=VS for the squared Fourier law S, e0(t)=V_A^-1(y0+V_Ac t), b=E|S_A+e0(S_Ac)| and epsilon=P(Y!=y0). The actual restriction entropy drop L_A obeys L_A=H(Y|S_Ac)+J_A<=H(Y|S_Ac)+(2/ln2)b, with b<=r epsilon. If all proper physical restrictions have ratio at most R(f)=H(f)/I(f), then R(f)I_A<=H(Y|S_Ac)+(2/ln2)b<=h2(epsilon)+epsilon log2(2^r-1)+(2r/ln2)epsilon. If instead D_K(f)>0 and every proper restriction has D_K<=0, replace the left side by KI_A+D_K(f). For every nonzero physical flip mask u and pivot i in its support, epsilon_u=(1-|E f(x)f(x+u)|)/2 satisfies the rank-one bound R(f)I_i<=h2(epsilon_u)+(2/ln2)epsilon_u (or its threshold-critical version). No connectedness or universal influence payment is claimed.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs on finite uniform cubes; entropy in bits
V has positive rank r; A consists of r physical coordinates and V_A is invertible over F2
Ratio conclusions require I(f)>0 and the stated all-proper-physical-restriction comparison; constants have H=I=0
Threshold conclusions require fixed finite K>=0, positive root deficit and nonpositive deficits in all proper physical restrictions
